newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Aluminium to produce condensers in Czech Republic.
newsitem.headline: Showa Aluminium to produce condensers in Czech Republic.

text.p: Showa Aluminium Corp said on Tuesday that it would invest 2.5 billion yen to produce condensers for car air conditioners in the Czech Republic.
Showa Aluminium said it would form a unit in the republic later this month, and planned to start mass production in January 1999.
The unit will be capable of producing 40,000 condensers a month, Showa Aluminium said, and is expected to employ 150 workers.
Showa Aluminium said it has been exporting air-conditioning condensers to Europe, but decided to produce them there due to sharply rising demand and growing requests to produce them locally.
